component.name: NfoGlow
component.summary: View NFO and ANSI art the way it was meant
NFO- und ANSI-Art so ansehen, wie sie gemeint ist

description.p: NfoGlow shows the info files of the release scene as they were drawn: block graphics are painted as exact pixels with an optional soft glow, the text stays crisp, and CP437 works out of the box.
NfoGlow zeigt die Info-Dateien der Release-Szene so, wie sie gezeichnet wurden: Blockgrafik wird pixelgenau gemalt, auf Wunsch mit weichem Glühen, der Text bleibt scharf, und CP437 klappt ab Werk.

ul.li: NFO, DIZ and ANSI art with colours
NFO, DIZ und ANSI-Art in Farbe
Glow as soft edges or neon, a glow around the text and a colour ramp through the art
Glühen als weiche Kanten oder Neon, Glühen um den Text und Farbverlauf durch die Grafik
Retro: scanlines, shadow mask or aperture grille, a live CRT with picture noise, a colour fringe like an old CRT and the IBM VGA font of the old PCs
Retro: Scanlines, Loch- oder Streifenmaske, Live-CRT mit Bildrauschen, Farbsaum wie bei einer alten Röhre und die IBM-VGA-Schrift der alten PCs
Demoscene mode: colour cycling, a wobbling logo, drifting or warp stars, a gleam, sparkles, a sine scroller and a glow that pulses to the beat
Demoszene-Modus: Farbzyklus, wabbelndes Logo, treibende oder Warp-Sterne, Glanzlicht, Glitzern, Laufschrift und Glühen im Takt der Musik
Eight effects on opening, from a 2400 baud modem build-up to a C64 tape loader, a DOS boot and a code rain
Acht Effekte beim Öffnen, vom Modem mit 2400 Baud über den C64-Kassettenlader und den DOS-Start bis zum Code-Regen
Six styles that set all effects at once, a random look with one click, and undo
Sechs Stile, die alle Effekte auf einmal setzen, ein zufälliger Look per Klick und Rückgängig
Optional music: nine chiptunes by Stennish (CC BY 4.0), or your MOD/XM/S3M/IT tracks
Musik auf Wunsch: neun Chiptunes von Stennish (CC BY 4.0) oder deine MOD/XM/S3M/IT-Tracks
Seven themes, among them black on white and the C64 screen, plus your own colours, any monospace font, zoom
Sieben Farbschemata, darunter Schwarz-Weiß und der C64-Bildschirm, plus eigene Farben, jede Festbreitenschrift, Zoom
Text-only view, search and copying without the art
Nur-Text-Ansicht, Suche und Kopieren ohne die Grafik
Browse a release folder, open NFOs straight from ZIP and ReScene (.srr) files
Release-Ordner durchblättern, NFOs direkt aus ZIP- und ReScene-Dateien (.srr) öffnen
Repairs NFOs broken by a wrong encoding
Repariert NFOs mit kaputter Zeichenkodierung
Clickable links and export as PNG or PDF
Anklickbare Links und Export als PNG oder PDF

description.p: Selecting text by dragging now scrolls along when the pointer gets close to the edge of the window, also in a maximized window; before it only scrolled once the pointer was outside of it. Updates have their own page in the preferences.

Stepping through a folder with the arrow keys no longer leaves the page dim: a key press during the fade, or a held arrow key, used to cut it off or restart it. A file opened from the file manager in the Flatpak is matched to its real folder more carefully.
In the Flatpak, a file opened from the file manager or the file chooser finds the other NFOs of its folder again, so the arrow keys step through them.

The effects on opening now start with the first picture, so the tape loader, the modem build-up and the others are no longer a third gone when the window shows. Stepping through a folder with the arrow keys fades the next NFO in instead of playing the opening effect every time.

The window follows the light or dark mode of the desktop, changing the language no longer leaves the old window open, the text-only view splits old Mac line ends, and the effects sidebar is grouped more clearly.
Smooth edges for the block art, a pulse on the beat of the built-in tracks, an optional update check, and a pasted look that waits for Keep.
